rca of the issue: Root cause of Launch page failure: Launch.jsx destructured `[on, setOn] = useState(false)` but not `[video, setVideo]`, yet lines 90 and 96 referenced `setVideo` and `video`. React rendering the JSX expression `{video && <Storyboard />}` triggered a ReferenceError at first paint, causing the CTA row to fail and the 'Play storyboard' button to never mount. Reproduction: navigate to /launch and observe pageerror 'video is not defined'. Fix: added `const [video, setVideo] = useState(false);` next to the existing state hook. Verified button renders, click opens fixed-overlay storyboard with auto-advancing captions.
